L2·N1704unmasked layer
Fires almost exclusively on the token " of" in nominalization/quantifier + "of" frames ("prediction of", "manufacturing of", "payment of", "one of"), plus a few fixed-collocation head nouns ("one single", "hard time", "wrong way"); notably the same " of" slot after other nouns ("acquisition of", "use of", "cost of") drives it strongly negative, so it is a surface-form "of"-position detector rather than a semantic one.

L2·N5873unmasked layer
Fires on word-final subword continuation pieces that complete a preceding token into a full word or proper name (e.g. "New|ly", "Hanz|al", "Clay|mont", "Mull|ins"), plus a few short function-word completions of set phrases ("at it", "so not") — i.e. it marks mid-word/word-completing fragments rather than any semantic category.
